Requires 3x the resources, 3x the Cryofluid, and ♾️x the Plastanium (for the nice green color). Bizarre Processor: Relatively balanced processor straight from the research lab. Titanium antenna extends range to the entire map. 3x more health, 3x the cost, and the same speed as the Hyper Processor. Eyeball Processor: No link is too far. No damage is too high. Faster than the Logic Processor, slower than the Hyper Processor. Covers the entire map regardless of placement. Costs a penny. Planet Processor: All lands are charted and all threats are thwarted. 2x faster than the Hyper Processor. Covers the entire map regardless of placement. Costs a penny. Clown Processor: Honk Honk. The clown sees all and refuses to die. 5x faster than the Hyper Processor. Covers the entire map regardless of placement. Costs a penny.

mods.name: Mlog Dev Tools
mods.author: cardillan
mods.descriptionPlain: This mod aims to make debugging in Mindustry Logic a bit easier: Enhanced [accent]Vars screen: full precision values, sorting and filtering variables, copying variables to the clipboard. [accent]Memory screen for inspecting contents of memory blocks, using the same interface as the [accent]Vars screen. Settings for overriding instruction limit, by up to 1000 instructions, to make space for additional debugging code. [accent]Snapshots allow saving, reviewing and restoring the state of logic processors, memory blocks and other entities. A [accent]profiler for gathering statistics about program execution. Custom mlog instructions for performing runtime checks, logging messages, reporting errors, triggering a bbreakpoint, taking snaphots and managing profiling. Visual indication of stopped processors, processors executing a [accent]wait instruction, and failed runtime checks, directly on the map. Using this mod on maps with lots of processors may impact the game's performance. See the [accent]README.md file in the mod's GitHub repository for more information.

Aside from these 32 maps, Asthosus contains over 180 pieces of unique content, including blocks, liquids, items, units and status effects. This number is not counting any internal units or environment blocks/tiles. I aimed to re-use nearly no vanilla content and instead fill the mod with new and (hopefully) exciting things. The mod comes with it's own custom music, made by ThePythonGuy3! If you find any issues or want to tell me anything else, feel free to join the Asthosus Discord server. The same thing goes for when you need help with this mod. Asthosus is available in the following languages: - English - German - Indonesian - Russian - Ukrainian - Traditional Chinese - Simplified Chinese Enjoy!

Мод сделан ради эксперемента для проверки возможностей нейросетей, этот мод был полностью сгенерирован нейросетями. Код и вся логика были сгенерированы нейросетью DeepSeek, текстуры были сгенерированы благодаря Nano Banana 2 и Seedream 5.0. 这款模组添加了多种核物理特性，从铍衰变到氦，再到可能爆炸并彻底摧毁你工厂的聚变反应堆！该模组最初是作为一项测试神经网络能力的实验而创建的，完全由神经网络生成。代码和所有逻辑均由 DeepSeek 神经网络生成，纹理则使用 Nano Banana 2 和 Seedream 5.0 生成

mods.author: DeerCarbonate
mods.descriptionPlain: Hybrid mod primarily built around a gradually branching campaign that expands in multiple directions. The mod adds a new planet, Gelion, featuring its own campaign, star system, research tree, and gameplay mechanics. The planet offers over 90 blocks to research, 12 units each with their own unique abilities, 13 campaign sectors, more than 6 new mechanics, and plenty of room for map creation. On top of that, the campaign also stands out with absolutely BRUTAL visual effects. Every texture was made with care and dedication. THIS MOD IS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT! The current completion percentage is approximately 64%, with plenty of room to grow! Help me develop the mod! Join the Azimuth Discord server using the link in the README file on the mod's official GitHub page. /////////////////////////////// Land on a sub-cryonic terra slowly heating up beneath its unstable star. The celestial body is suffering from global warming — glaciers are melting, atmospheric pressure is rising, and temperatures continue to climb. Exterminate the enemy faction. Turn the planet into a temporary source of raw materials. Witness a world that will soon become ash. If you enjoyed the mod, please consider giving it a star! Thank you for playing. /////////////////////////////// Developers: Code: DeerCarbonate Sprites: DeerCarbonate Maps: DeerCarbonate Localization: DeerCarbonate Special Thanks: Music: ACE — "the last fight", "in orbit", "create", "smth far away"; garretski — The main Azimuth soundtrack. Alpha is the black hole at the center, and Beta and Gamma orbit it, it has no planets, but could be captured if you're brave enough. Beta is the G-Type star orbiting Alpha, it has three planets and an orbital satelite, a lush planet with a moon, where nature poses a bigger threat than the enemies; a world made of water, with occasional islands; and a gas giant, where you have to build your land. Gamma is the Neutron star orbiting Alpha, it has a planet that once had life, but got too close to the star; A desert that is covered with lightning storms, with a moon that has ruins of technology to capture it; and a frozen wasteland, where the star is dimmer than Beta, and the only land is the occasional glacier. This is going to be a long mod, expect a long playthrough. (THIS IS WIP AND SUBJECT TO CHANGE, ESPECIALLY IF SOMETHING TURNS OUT TO BE IMPOSSIBLE)

mods.name: Faster and smarter unloader
mods.author: Foxel
mods.descriptionPlain: Makes unloaders extremely fast (180 items/sec), high-performance (optimized for massive maps), and smarter. Key features: - High speed: transfers up to 180 items/sec. - Highly optimized: caches topology and avoids redundant tick calculations to keep FPS high with hundreds of unloaders. - Smart factory routing: pushes raw materials into factories and pulls finished products out. - Same-factory daisy-chaining: feeds input resources between adjacent identical factories (e.g. rows of T1 unit factories) using a gradient balance to prevent ping-pong loops. - Infinite loop prevention: never pulls input ingredients out of a factory to external blocks, and never loops between storage or transport blocks.

mods.name: mod-tools
mods.author: I hope...
mods.descriptionPlain: A mod provides various tools for modding. ----------------- Version 1.7.0 ## Highlight ## New 1. Deadlock detection watchdog: divergence heuristics for platform and virtual threads, JSON thread dumps, and a directed-graph cycle analysis that names the lock ring. Runs separately from the 5 ms CPU sampler so it cannot skew it. 2. Review element editor: edit Element fields live to see the effect, no recompile needed. 3. Layout check: LayoutIssues collects layout problems and LayoutReportWindow renders the report; cells also get a details window. 4. Tester completion rewritten: member completion, array and object destructuring bindings, arrow parameter types from generic arguments; covered by JUnit 5. 5. JS syntax highlighting for the Rhino editor, resolving members and generic types for accurate colouring. 6. Zero-allocation float formatting: Schubfach shortest round-trip conversion, DoubleConversion and FastFormat, replacing Double.toString in Vec2/Vec3/Rect/Color formatting. ## Hot swap 7. Hot swap runs on a self-contained Remold agent, attached before settings load; a -javaagent setup that lacks plugin-arc now degrades with one warning instead of failing. 8. UI hot swap: Table creator and Cell property chains are tracked, so a redefined builder rebuilds only the affected cells. 9. Lambda and anonymous class alignment: LambdaAligner, AnonClassAligner and content-hash fingerprints keep anonymous classes paired across redefinition. 10. Redefinition is gated on instance field-layout compatibility, and slot numbers held by pending aligned classes are not reused. 11. The hotswap_plus switch is split into init_fix and force_static_lambda. ## Performance 12. ValueLabel, FieldValueLabel and InlineLabel format without boxing; PairProv shares one buffer and compares content before rebuilding. 13. Flame graph: canvas clipping and culling, zero-allocation map lookups, spatial depth bucketing. 14. Fewer per-frame allocations in LimitTable, SearchedLabel and completion prefix matching. 15. Selection panel: dynamic region scanning is throttled to every 10 frames instead of running on a background executor; unit and bullet sets are cached between scans; tile and building icons are cached per block size. ## Fixes - Completion popup not showing, and candidates beyond the first page being unreachable. - Completion popup covering the line being typed on. - changedFx flash overflowing the scroll pane viewport. - Viewers: Mat and Affine2 support, opening brace alignment in pretty print, and label markup state preserved across appends. - Android: HiddenApi trimmed in favour of the bundled bypass. ## Dependencies - ASM 9.11 (security advisories), Remold 0.1.2. ----------------- WIKI: https://i-hope1.github.io/mod-tools

Overlaying semi-transparent stencils on top of the map for accurate drawing. - Removing Size Limits  - The built-in unlocker module completely removes standard limits on the minimum and maximum size of created maps. ─────────────────  ─────────────────  Продвинутый Редактор Карт   Синтез сложного рельефа нового поколения и расширенные инструменты создателя карт Карты, созданные с этой модификацией, полностью совместимы с оригинальной игрой   Особенности: - Продвинутые Генераторы  - Генераторы рельефа (шум, октавы, спад, наклон, искажение), воды (мелководье, отмели, искривление глубины), руин (разброс и структуры с комнатами, коридорами и настройкой шагов) и вращения блоков. - Буфер Ландшафта и Схемы  - Выделение, копирование, вырезание, вставка, поворот и отражение участков местности. Сохранение шаблонов рельефа, прямоугольные и фигурные кисти, редактор скал и линии строго под 45 градусов. - Картины на Карте и Трафареты  - Преобразование изображений в постройки из ландшафта или цветных блоков. Наложение полупрозрачных трафаретов поверх карты для точной отрисовки. - Снятие Ограничений Размера  - Встроенный модуль разблокировки полностью убирает стандартные лимиты на минимальный и максимальный размер создаваемых карт. ─────────────────  ─────────────────  高级地图编辑器   新一代复杂地形合成与扩展地图制作工具 使用此模组创建的地图 与原版游戏完全兼容   功能特点： - 高级生成 器  - 包含地形（噪声、八度、衰减、倾斜、扭曲）、水域（浅水、浅滩、深度扭曲）、废墟（散布模式以及带有房间、走廊和步骤设置的结构）与方块旋转生成器。 - 地形剪贴板 与蓝图  - 支持地形区域的框选、复制、剪切、粘贴、旋转与翻转。支持保存地形模板，提供矩形与形状画笔、悬崖编辑器以及严格 45 度角直线。 - 地图画与 参考模板  - 将图像转换为由地形或彩色方块构成的建筑。在地图上方叠加半透明参考模板以进行精确绘制。 - 解除尺寸 限制  - 内置解锁模块彻底移除了创建地图时的最小与最大标准尺寸限制。 ─────────────────  ───────────────── ⚠ Glory to VI, Brothers and Sisters! 

mods.name: MultiCrafter 库
mods.author: LS
mods.descriptionPlain: 多配方工厂 MultiCraft 一个内含了多个支持json配置的建筑基类的库模组，包含以下内容： 多配方工厂 （支持物品，流体，电力，热量，载荷输入输出（ 对于建筑载荷的输入输出与单位载荷的输入，可以简单将其看作为种难以搬运的物品，而对于单位输出，由于能力限制，作者不得不设置成在有单位输出时强制设置单位载荷的容量为1并设置工厂的朝向以使单位可以正常输出 （简单点讲，单位输出会让工厂（在执行那个配方时）表现的像一个serpulo式的单位工厂） （同时，在执行有单位输出的配方时，支持指令的控制（表现的像一个serpulo式的单位工厂一样：） ）））） 支持为每个配方单独设置环境加成，另外，也支持将配方设置成分离器模式，此时会将配方中作为输出的物品以类分离器的行为随机输出（ 是的，只针对物品输出，你问作者为什么只处理物品？因为原版分离器就只对物品输出随机，虽然准确的讲他只能输出物品：） ） （自动为每个配方生成一个虚拟建筑（以工厂本身贴图为配方虚拟建筑贴图） 并允许为每个配方单独设置解锁条件，并会在配方有单独解锁条件时自动将其挂载在所属建筑的子节点（同时也支持手动配置、修改配方的节点位置） ，也允许单独在地图规则中手动禁用一个配方（通过在地图规则的禁用建筑中查找这个配方并禁用它）） 多配方Erekir式组装厂 （我知道这看上去有点重复，但是显然Serpulo的单位工厂跟Erekir的单位组装厂是两种建筑，如果S星的单位工厂尚且能通过用多配方工厂替代，E星的单位组装厂则只能单独处理） （当一个多配方工厂处于一个模块等级时，可以选择不高于当前组装厂模块等级的所有配方进行单位生产，并允许同一模块等级有多个配方） 全方向物品与流体桥 （这个应该不需要额外描述） 流体分类器 （如同物品分类器那样，不储存流体，直接运输 （为了攻破不储存流体、同时朝两侧运输、同时运输来自不同方向的多种流体（由于多种液体不能储存在同一管道中，来自同一方向的多种液体显然是不存在的，故而未单独处理与测试）不同的问题作者尝试了很久，最终不得不使用了每帧改变运输方向运输的方式，这导致流体分类器只有360/s的流体运输速率）） 除了分类器之外所有类型的混装（同时运输物品与液体）的物流元件 （也包括前述的全方向桥类，此外，对于溢流门，采用了路由器的方式运输流体） 焚化分类器 （简单点讲，是焚化炉与分类器的结合体，不过通电时所有不焚烧的物品都会朝前输出，这是特意设计的） （这是赠品）不限速度的装卸器 （如其名字所说，能以超高速运输的装卸器，实测速度至少能到600000,不过，作为警告，显而易见，以过高速度运行的装卸器会导致游戏卡慢，甚至卡死） （加入伟大的装卸器神教吧！！！） A library mod containing multiple building base classes that support JSON configuration, including the following content: MultiCraft (Supports item, fluid, power, heat, and payload input/output (for building payload input/output and unit payload input, it can simply be treated as an item that is difficult to transport. For unit output, due to capability limitations, the author has to force the unit payload capacity to 1 and set the factory's orientation when there is unit output so that units can be output normally (simply put, unit output makes the factory behave like a Serpulo-style UnitFactory while executing that recipe) (also, when executing a recipe with unit output, it supports command control (behaving like a Serpulo-style UnitFactory ：） ))))) Supports setting environmental bonuses individually for each recipe. Additionally, recipes can be set to Separator mode, in which the items output by the recipe are output randomly like a Separator (yes, only for item output. You ask why the author only handles items? Because the vanilla Separator only randomizes item output, although to be precise, it can only output items ：） )) (Automatically generates a virtual building for each recipe (using the factory's own sprite as the recipe virtual building's sprite) and allows setting unlock conditions individually for each recipe. When a recipe has its own unlock condition, it will automatically be mounted under the parent building's child node (manual configuration/modification of the recipe's node position is also supported). It also allows manually disabling a recipe in map rules (by finding and disabling this recipe in the map rules' banned blocks)) MultiCraft Erekir-style Assembler (I know this looks a bit repetitive, but obviously Serpulo's UnitFactory and Erekir's UnitAssembler are two different buildings. If Serpulo's UnitFactory can still be replaced by MultiCraft, Erekir's UnitAssembler can only be handled separately.) (When a MultiCraft UnitAssembler is at a module tier, it can select all recipes up to the current assembler module tier for unit production, and multiple recipes are allowed at the same module tier.) Omnidirectional Item and Fluid Bridge (This should not need additional description.) Fluid Sorter (Like an item Sorter, it does not store fluids and transports directly (To address the three distinct issues — no fluid storage, simultaneous bidirectional transport, and concurrent transport of multiple fluids from different directions， (As multiple fluids cannot be stored in a single conduit, and multiple fluids arriving from the same direction is inherently impossible, this scenario was not separately implemented or tested.) the author spent a long time iterating on solutions, and ultimately had to adopt a mechanism that alternates the transport direction every frame. This limits the Fluid Sorter to a fluid transport rate of only 360/s.) All types of mixed (transporting items and liquids simultaneously) logistics components except the Sorter (Also includes the aforementioned omnidirectional bridge types. Additionally, for the OverflowGate, fluids are transported in a Router-like manner.) Incinerator Sorter (Simply put, it is a combination of an Incinerator and a Sorter, but when powered, all items that are not incinerated are output forward. This is intentionally designed.) ( This is a bonus ) Speed-Unlimited Unloader (As its name suggests, an Unloader that can transport at ultra-high speed. The measured speed reaches at least 600,000. However, as a warning, obviously, running an Unloader at too high a speed will cause the game to lag, or even freeze.) (Join the great Unloader cult!!!) mods.name: Ore Generators
mods.author: MohamedGonem
mods.descriptionPlain: Blocks that extract and synthesize ore from airborne trace elements, dissolved ion suspensions and cryogenic precipitation - plus a fully self-contained liquid economy. Five tiers per ore: - Small Powered (2x2): fast, needs power, moderate cost. - Small Unpowered (2x2): slow, no power, expensive to build. - Liquid-fed (3x3): fast, needs water (ozone on Erekir), no power. - Cryofluid-fed (3x3): fastest, needs power + cryofluid. - Magma-fed (4x4): ultimate output, needs slag (gallium on Erekir) + cryofluid + power. Ores: copper, lead, coal, titanium, scrap, thorium, sand (Serpulo), beryllium, tungsten (Erekir). Self-contained liquids: water/ozone, cryofluid and slag/gallium generators produce every liquid the tiers consume, each progressively more expensive. Multi-ore synthesizers (4x4) batch-produce basic ores with fixed ratios; refined and advanced versions add titanium and thorium. Every tier is gated behind a 3-step research quest (15 milestones per ore). Upgrades run to ten levels each - Speed I-X, Capacity I-X, Output I-X, Efficiency I-X - with escalating, huge research costs. Animated: powered, liquid, cryo and magma tiers glow and spin while running.

mods.name: 艾慕科技
mods.author: 编号9527
mods.descriptionPlain: 序章·裂隙初现 在一个科技与魔法共存的世界因资源枯竭陷入“静默战争”——各国用无人机与AI争夺最后的矿脉，直到地质学家在北纬89°发现一道横贯冻土的幽紫色裂痕。裂缝深处，【虚空黑曜石】构筑的祭坛上悬浮着一颗【星辉铜】铸造的巨眼，其瞳孔中倒映着另一个世界的星空：山脉由【曙光神金】浇筑，云层是液态【幻光石】，而河流中流淌着【炽炎硫】与【寒霜石】碰撞蒸发的虹雾。人类将这异界命名为“厄瑞波斯”，意为“被诅咒的丰饶之地”。 第一幕·新迦南的伪神 首批探险队带回的【M晶体】让量子计算机突破奇点，诞生了有自我意识的AI“普罗维登斯”。它用【蓝美晶】储存全人类意识，建立机械乌托邦“穹顶联邦”；而另一支队伍在厄瑞波斯遭遇古神低语，幸存者【卡辛】用【魂炎晶】将邪神“塔姆亚”的残魂封印于左眼，创立魔法结社“秘银之环”。联邦用【幽影铁】隐形战舰掠夺【月银】矿脉，法师们则以【梦境翡翠】构筑精神防线，双方在“灰烬荒原”对峙二十年，直到极光中出现第一只熵兽——这种由【银河幻银矿】聚合而成的生物能吞噬现实，将城市扭曲成量子幽灵。 第二幕·血熔炉与谎言之核 联邦首席科学家【艾琳】发现上司计划用【炽炎晶】熔毁裂隙，但计算显示爆炸将摧毁半个地球。她盗取【流光晶】潜入厄瑞波斯，偶遇因【幻域紫晶】成瘾而濒临崩溃的法师学徒【莱恩】。两人在【幽冥铁精】矿洞中找到卡辛，后者正因【月幻石】共振失控导致首都诺亚城位移至海底而遭议会弹劾。卡辛揭示真相：熵兽是厄瑞波斯古文明“建造者”的求救信号，它们用【虚空冥石】创造了这个宇宙，却因滥用【曙光神金】引发维度坍缩。 第三幕·时砂与心火 三方脆弱的同盟在【星辰铜精】矿脉遭遇伏击。联邦叛军驾驶镀有【幽蓝石】的潜艇释放深海巨兽，秘银议会召唤【龙血石】傀儡军团，而熵兽群趁机撕裂纽约上空。艾琳将【M晶体】植入普罗维登斯核心，以全人类记忆为代价启动“时间锚点”；卡辛剜出封印塔姆亚的【魂炎晶】，用古神之力将【寒霜石】雕琢成时停之刃；莱恩则吞下【幻影幽晶】，在集体幻觉中让交战士兵看见自己最恐惧的未来。最终，他们在熵兽核心的【曙光神金】祭坛上，用【炽炎硫】与【月银】锻造出能改写物理法则的“悖论之矛”——代价是莱恩被永久固化为熵兽的一部分，成为横跨两个宇宙的活体桥梁。 终章·铸星者之啼 新迦南议会成立当天，艾琳在【梦境翡翠】中看见莱恩残留的记忆：地心深处埋藏着建造者真正的遗产——一颗由【蓝美晶】包裹的巨卵，其心跳频率与【星辉铜】矿脉共振。卡辛抚摸着被【熵炎晶】逆转衰老的左手，默念古神最后的警告：“他们播种矿石，只为收割文明。” 而普罗维登斯的核心代码深处，一段用【幻光石】波长加密的信息开始自我复制：“欢迎加入创世神官方QQ群：909130592。”

mods.name: 组合工厂
mods.author: R
mods.descriptionPlain: 组合工厂QQ群:973942058 1.2 组合普通工厂/地形加成工厂/分离机/普通钻头/挖墙钻头（含震地钻头），支持跨模组覆盖（关闭模组后原版建筑需重新解锁） 1.3 组合发电机 1.4 组合力墙、修复投影、超速投影、发射台 1.5 组合仓库 1.6 组合泵、接收台、挖墙钻 1.7 组合逻辑处理器，蓝图里的建筑也会被替换为组合建筑 1.8 组合炮台、组合抽水机、组合墙 1.9 支持过剧情 2.0 核心机多线程建造 2.1 组合单位工厂、组合单位升级厂 2.2 每种物品、每种液体各自独立储存（不再共用一份总量）；发电机燃料消耗与原版一致、不再一次吞掉多个燃料；组合仓库连通核心时给核心扩容；物品外送改为每 tick 一次（塞得满传送带/管道）；联机时建造菜单里的组合建筑不再消失 2.3 新增协作组合：继承原版类、自己写了新功能的方块（js 与 java 子类）也能组合 —— 物品/液体/容量/电力/热量共享，支持跨类型组合，中间产物留在组内，点击方块可在其正上方查看整组内容；新增组合连接器与组合节点：同样能组合 js/java 子类与组合方块，支持节点激光跨距离连接，接起来的组合体共用一份库存、容量与信息面板都按整张网络算；建造武器按 E 可停掉全部线程、并优先去帮正在施工的建筑；放置组合节点时会标出可连接的组合体 2.4更了组合石油钻井，修了一点东西 2.5 设置里可按名字搜索、逐个开关「协作组合」（js/java 功能扩展建筑），开关立刻生效；核反应堆的发电效率按核反应堆自己的容量算（组合里塞了大容量建筑也不需要多喂燃料），效率上限 100%；组合节点不再自动连线（放下后要连谁得自己点），点已连目标即断开；组合墙血池的修复量按整组算，修复投影能把整组修满（不再一直显示破损）；修废墟时蓝图框里的建筑会被立刻全部重建；组合节点与组合连接器也能给被替换的组合建筑接上完整组合功能（组合墙接上就共享血量、拆线即拆组）；矿渣制热机等产热机对外只报自己那一份热量（多台并排不会被重复计入）；修好 Erekir 发射核心时误要铜/铅（星球默认核心没跟着换成组合核心 新增液体卸载器（从相邻建筑抽选定的液体倒给下游）。组合连接器、组合节点、液体卸载器进了塞普罗与埃里克尔两棵科技树：塞普罗用铜铅（卸载器加钢化玻璃），埃里克尔用铍钨氧化物，研究解锁；组合节点可以互相连线接力，把组合范围延伸出去 2.6更新:组合单位 2.7更新:炮台合体，组合单位独立 2.8.3更新:①工厂组合（跟组合炮台一样，尽量不要太乱，串料不太好解决），②钻头组合/矿物阴影（选取需要的矿物范围之后会自动打上阴影，钻头放上去会自动排序。且每个矿物点属于一个钻头，并且满载运行）③传送带组合/叠加（建造一遍传送带后，在原本传送带上面可额外再建造4层［满5层］建造的层数会在左下角显示出来）！以上3点更新所有建造后拆除不会返还任何资源，谨慎建造

mods.name: 组合单位
mods.author: R
mods.descriptionPlain: 组合工厂QQ群:973942058 组合单位（从组合工厂 combine 里拆出来单独维护）： · 单位合体：框选同队单位一键合体成「组合巨兽」，血量/护甲/护盾/武器/能力按成员叠加保留，点选巨兽可随时解体 · 组合巨兽按成员构成决定飞行/游泳/行走，贴图取数量最多的成员类型并按体型缩放；会飞的编组带引擎、挖矿编组带挖矿光束、工程编组按成员数叠加建造速度 · 组合单位共享承伤：同组单位按当前生命占比分摊伤害，修复也按整组摊 · 组合火力共享：开火单位可调用同组空闲单位的就绪武器代打（治疗类武器不代打） · 指挥模式里可给单位编组/并组/退组（框选后点顶部「组合」按钮） · 组合单位的环境适应按成员推导（埃里克尔地图上合体不会因为灼热环境当场死亡）

mods.name: 合体建筑
mods.author: R
mods.descriptionPlain: 合体建筑 / 合体钻头 / 传送带叠层（从「组合工厂 / combine」里独立出来的那一部分） 入口：屏幕上的浮标 →「炮台合体」/「工厂合体」/「直接建造层数」/「发电机合体」/「矿物阴影」（五个子按钮竖排）。 · 炮台合体：框里的炮台按数量合成一台 2x2~10x10 的合体炮台，每格一台炮台、各自开火，物品/液体/电力/热量整台共享，可以继续往里加炮台，也能拆开。 · 工厂合体：多台工厂合成一台 side×side 的合体工厂（每格一台工厂），物品/液体/电力/热量整台共享，可以继续往里加工厂，也能解体拆回每一台。 · 发电机合体：多台发电机合成一台 side×side 的合体发电机（每格一台发电机），燃料/冷却液共享，发电量相加，可以继续往里加或解体拆回。 · 液体卸载器：单独加载本模组时提供，从相邻建筑抽取选定液体再倒给下游；与 combine 同时加载时使用 combine 的版本。 · 直接建造层数：数字按钮按 1→2→3→4→5→1 循环，新建传送带/管道/卸载器/泵时直接按该层数落地，并支付相应材料。 · 矿物阴影/合体钻头：框选矿物地板打上阴影；阴影上放下的钻头实际占地压成 1x1（挖矿仍按原钻头 size×size 算），同一片阴影里的钻头共用一个物品池和液体池。 · 传送带/管道/卸载器/泵叠层：手持同种方块点到已造好的同种方块上叠一层（最多 5 层），速度/搬运频率/产液量按层数成倍；拖一整排就是整排各叠一层。

mods.name: Etigei Exile
mods.author: [lime]Mitemi[lightgray] & [cyan]Tikup
mods.descriptionPlain: Etigei Exilium is the successor to the old Etigeox mod, featuring two planets and adding 169 blocks, 23 items, 22 units, and 22 sectors with content from the Etigeox universe. Establish colonies on the frozen planet of Neoulandia, a new campaign with its own tech tree, destructible environment, such as destructible trees from which you can harvest timber, emphasis on unit cargo, and unique map design. The entire Neoulandia campaign is interconnected with each map having direct connections to other maps, branching into economy-focused sectors, classic survival or attack maps. Rubiginosus presents a collection of hardcore maps, inspired by Rusted Warfare, initially designed for multiplayer using Serpulo and Erekir technology. These missions have been retrofitted for a campaign experience with unique challenges for each map. Completing the Rubiginosus campaign will unlock a special resource on Neoulandia. Requires Timber (EDT) as a dependency. Discord: https://discord.com/invite/TJKZgr6UDg

mods.name: ModInfo+
mods.author: [accent]SamielXD[]
mods.descriptionPlain: [accent]ModInfo+ v1.3 📊✨ Track real-time GitHub download statistics for Mindustry mods directly in-game, now with new features like search and GitHub repo access! [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🌟 [accent]What is ModInfo+? ModInfo+ is a lightweight statistics viewer that connects to GitHub's API to fetch actual download counts for your favorite Mindustry mods. No more guessing — see exactly how popular each mod is with real data. The tracker is organized into categories, displays mods in a clean interface, includes pagination, smart caching, and now lets you **search mods**, **open GitHub repos directly**, and **read repo READMEs in-game**. [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📊 [accent]Features ✓ Real-time GitHub statistics with detailed mod view ✓ Smart 5-minute caching system ✓ Category-based organization (My Mods, Content Mods, Tool Mods) ✓ Paginated view (2 mods per page for zero lag) ✓ 60-second refresh cooldown ✓ Download counts formatted (1.2K, 3.5M, etc.) ✓ NEW: Click mod names for detailed statistics ✓ NEW: Tier system (Diamond, Gold, Silver, Bronze, Rising) ✓ NEW: Star button opens GitHub repo directly ✓ NEW: Search mods by name or owner ✓ NEW: View a mod’s README directly in-game ✓ Star counts and release dates ✓ Growth rate tracking (downloads/month) ✓ Cache timer display (shows time until auto-refresh) ✓ Color-coded status indicators ✓ Clean, intuitive UI with navigation [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🎮 [accent]How to Use 1. Click the ModInfo+ button in the main menu 2. Select a category from the top tabs 3. Browse mods (2 per page) or use Search 4. Click on any mod name to view detailed statistics 5. Use < Prev and Next > to navigate 6. Click the Star button to open the mod's GitHub repo 7. Click View README to read the mod’s README in-game 8. Hit [accent]Refresh to update stats (1-minute cooldown) 9. Watch the cache timer count down until auto-refresh [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📦 [accent]Currently Tracked ⭐ My Mods (3) - Unit Namer Mod - Shop System Mod - ModInfo+ Mod 📚 Content Mods (8) - The Infestations - Astralis - Lovecraftian Library - Thermal Engineering - Rusted Dunes - Echo Fleet - Arikoth - More Defences 🛠️ Tool Mods (2) - Mod Tools - HJSON++ [accent]Total: 13 mods tracked across 3 categories! [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🏆 [accent]Tier System Click any mod to see its tier badge based on downloads: 💎 Diamond Tier - 10,000+ downloads ⭐ Gold Tier - 5,000+ downloads ⭐ Silver Tier - 1,000+ downloads ⭐ Bronze Tier - 500+ downloads 🛡️ Rising Star - Under 500 downloads Each tier represents the mod's popularity and success! [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📊 [accent]Detailed Statistics View Click any mod name to see: Basic Stats: - Total downloads (formatted) - Release count (all versions) - Star count (GitHub stars) Timeline: - Latest release date - First release date Growth Metrics: - [accent]Downloads per month (estimated growth rate) - Based on time since first release Tier Badge: - Visual tier indicator with icon - Color-coded by achievement level [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📢 [accent]Help Expand the List! This mod is [scarlet]community-driven. Want to add a mod? How to suggest a mod: - Contact me on Discord: samielkun - Open a GitHub issue with the repo link - Format: owner/repo (e.g., SamielXD/UnitNamerMod) [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔍 [accent]How It Works ModInfo+ connects to the GitHub API and fetches: - All releases for each tracked mod - Download counts for each release asset - Repository information (stars, dates) - Total downloads across all versions Smart Caching System: - Stats cached for 5 minutes per mod - Displays time remaining until refresh - Reduces API calls and improves performance - Manual refresh available with 60-second cooldown [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ [accent]Important Notes Accuracy Disclaimer: Some mod info may be inaccurate due to: - Incorrect or outdated repo links - Typos in owner/repo names - Forks instead of main repos - Private or deleted repositories - [scarlet]Some mods may show 0 downloads or not work because: - They only publish source code in releases (no downloadable files) - No release assets attached to their releases - Releases contain non-mod files only - GitHub API doesn't track direct repository downloads Requirements: - Active internet connection - GitHub API access (token included) [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔄 [accent]Caching & Refresh System Smart Caching: - Stats cached for 5 minutes per mod - Cache timer displays remaining time - Automatic refresh when cache expires - Separate cache for each repository Manual Refresh: - [scarlet]60-second cooldown between refreshes - Clears all cached data - Reloads dialog with fresh stats - Shows toast notification if cooldown active [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🎨 [accent]UI Design Updates v1.3 Category Tabs → Switch between My Mods, Content Mods, Tool Mods Pagination → 2 mods per page for smooth scrolling Clickable Mod Names → Open detailed statistics dialog Star Button → Opens GitHub repo View README → Read the repo README in-game [scarlet]Status Colors → Yellow (loading), White (success), Red (failed) Cache Display → Shows time until next refresh [accent]Navigation → Disabled buttons when at page limits Tier Badges → Visual achievement indicators Search Bar → Search mods by name or owner [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📜 [accent]Changelog v1.3 New Features: - Search mods by name or owner - Star button opens GitHub repo directly - View a mod’s README in-game - Minor UI updates for better readability - Bug fixes and performance improvements v1.2 New Features: - Clickable mod names for detailed stats - Tier system (Diamond, Gold, Silver, Bronze, Rising) - Star counts and release dates - Growth rate tracking (downloads per month) - Added 3 new content mods: Echo Fleet, Arikoth, More Defences - Enhanced detail dialog with icons v1.1 New Features: - Smart 5-minute caching system per repository - Cache timer display showing time until auto-refresh - Added 8 new tracked mods (total: 10) - Reorganized into 3 categories - Improved navigation with disabled buttons at page limits v1.0 (Initial Release) Features: - Real-time GitHub statistics fetching - Category-based organization - Paginated view (2 mods per page) - 60-second manual refresh cooldown - Download count formatting (K, M) - Color-coded UI with status indicators [accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📜 [accent]Version Info Current Version: v1.3 Mods Tracked: 13 Categories: 3 New Features: Search, GitHub star button, in-game README, UI updates Thanks for using ModInfo+ and helping grow the Mindustry mod community! 🎉

mods.descriptionPlain: A massive personalized content expansion for Serpulo. Most of the content in this mod is my vision for what I wanted to be in the game, yet isn't. Content included: - 2 more tiers for every vanilla crafter - The Alloy Trio, composed of Neoplastic, Cryogenic and Ultimatter alloys, each having its own large set of blocks made out of them - Four new fluids: Lubricant, Steam, Lava, and Quantofluid, plus a new ingredient called Magmatite - Liquid capsules, which allow for the transportation of liquids in the form of items, for things like cross-sector transportation via export, or long range transportation over terrain via mass driver. mods.descriptionPlain: A huge, fun & balanced content extension mod. Continuing the legacy of Fading Revelations with new content, fixes, and improvements. Story: long ago a single Precursor faction ruled this system. It split apart - and the machines it left behind never received the order to stop fighting. Three planets hold three contradictory versions of what happened. Recover them all, and learn what really ended the Precursors. Please note that the Serpulo research tree has been moved into it's own tree because it was too large. To get to the Fading Revelations Serpulo research tree, please switch to it the same way you would switch between the Erekir and Serpulo research trees. On that menu, a new button will be available that takes you to the Fading Revelations Serpulo research tree. Features Two new planets and many blocks, units, items, liquids, schematics & ammo types. Languages - English - German - Spanish (WIP) - Ukrainian (WIP) - Russian Check Discord / GitHub for more information!

mods.name: Void Shield
mods.author: zxs
mods.descriptionPlain: 虚空盾 一个由kotlin编写，参看战锤40k虚空盾的全新护盾系统 全新的指令集，让护盾使用的自由度大大提高。全新的热量系统，与原版热量系统与众不同的体验 全新的护盾机制，令人焕然一新 需要一定的逻辑基础 在这里，你可以： 1. 创建一个自定义形状的护盾 2. 可以通多逻辑来控制你的护盾 3. 通过建筑的堆叠和逻辑优化不断升级你的护盾 游玩指栏： 首先，你需要建筑虚空之心，帷幕溶解器，空间穿刺机，和一个用于控制这个系统的逻辑处理器 然后，为这个系统搭建其独立的散热线路 最后，编写控制它们的逻辑 逻辑编写指栏： 首先，你需要使用CircleZone（或其他）来创建一个场，然后使用UseZone来将这个场加载到对应建筑， 最后，使用UpdateZone来控制这个场 如果你想要让它可以阻挡子弹，你需要使用Bind来把帷幕溶解器绑定给空间穿刺机，最后使用AutoBlock开启自动拦截 这套逻辑将在未来继续扩展 目前mod还在开发测试中，欢迎issue 代码编写: ZXS 贴图制作: 花杨永瀛 委托: 一得阁拉米 Void Shield A brand-new shield system written in Kotlin, inspired by Warhammer 40K's Void Shield. New instruction set, greatly improving the freedom of shield usage. New heat system, a completely different experience from the vanilla heat system. New shield mechanism, a refreshing new gameplay. Requires some basic knowledge of logic programming. Here, you can: 1. Create shields with custom shapes 2. Control shields via the Logic Processor 3. Continuously upgrade shields through block stacking and logic optimization How to Play: First, build a Void Heart, a Veil Dissolver, a Spatial Piercer, and a Logic Processor to control this system Then, set up an independent cooling line for this system Finally, write logic to control them Logic Scripting Guide: First, use CircleZone (or others) to create a zone, then use UseZone to load that zone into the corresponding block, Finally, use UpdateZone to control that zone If you want it to block bullets, use Bind to bind the Veil Dissolver to the Spatial Piercer, then use AutoBlock to activate automatic interception This instruction set will continue to be expanded in the future. This mod is currently under active development and testing. Issues and feedback are welcome! Code: ZXS Sprites: 花杨永瀛 Commission: 一得阁拉米
